summary: Renders a race session HUD overlay for the current session state: draws a clipped backdrop, two blink-gated status widgets colored from the input state, four suspension corner position bars and four secondary corner indicators, a delta/highlight row, a fixed green marker, and up to four formatted text rows (position, time, event/round name, short state) using the render surface at this+0x8. A non-zero a2 renders only the backdrop.

operations.description: Return early when the display context at this+0x14 is null, when the draw width at (this+0x14) + 84 is null, or when the secondary context at this+0x1C is null.
Compute the blink phase v5 = (CRTFtol(dbl_8AFEA0) % 2) == 0 from the session time double at global 0x8AFEA0.
Draw the clipped backdrop with ClippedRectRender(0, 0, width, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0); when a2 is non-zero the function returns right after this draw.
Derive the first status-widget flag v7 from the input object dword_7C54E0: active when the dword at object + 3284 is set and either the byte at object + 3348 is set or the blink phase holds.
Render the first status widget with RenderDrawOperationWithClipping at (195, 26, 18, 53), green when active, red otherwise.
Derive the second status-widget flag v8 from the same input object dword_7C54E0 using the dword at object + 3352 and the byte at object + 3416 with the same blink logic.
Render the second status widget with RenderDrawOperationWithClipping at (42, 35, 14, 35), green when active, red otherwise.
Draw the four suspension corner position bars via SuspensionCornerCheck for corners 2, 0, 3, 1 at their grid positions.
Draw the four secondary corner indicators via sub_49E7B0 for corners 2, 0, 3, 1 at their grid positions.
Clear the one-shot HUD indicator byte_7C8B40 to 0 and capture its prior value to detect a change in this frame.

Highlight the delta row: when the value at dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] + 18580 differs from dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4] + 18580, or the one-shot indicator just cleared, render it green at (59, 49, 46, 6), otherwise yellow.
Render a fixed green marker with RenderDrawOperationWithClipping at (87, 45, 16, 13).
Proceed to text rendering only when the render surface at this+0x8 is non-null; otherwise return null.
Text row 1: sub_49C700 formats position text into a short buffer, then StringFormatAndRender draws it at (58, 105) using the surface and display context.
Text row 2: sub_49C770 formats time/gap text into a short buffer, then StringFormatAndRender draws it at (66, 105).
Text row 3: EventRoundNameLookup fills the event/round name into a short buffer, then StringFormatAndRender draws it at (184, 105).
Text row 4: ShortComputation_c8a0 formats a short state value into a short buffer, then StringFormatAndRender draws it at (192, 105); its return value is returned by this function.
Return the last StringFormatAndRender result, or null when the render surface was absent.

clean_pseudocode: int w1 = active_widget(dword_7C54E0, 3284, 3348, blink) ? GREEN : RED;
int w2 = active_widget(dword_7C54E0, 3352, 3416, blink) ? GREEN : RED;
